<div class="card-body">
'''Corellia''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[System]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊コレリア</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">自分のコレリアン・コルベットとミレニアム・ファルコンはここに“リアクション”として配備できる。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここから移動する場合、自分の宇宙船は航行速度＋1。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Corellia-SWCA-12641.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Corellia.

'''Light Side:'''
Your Corellian Corvette and Millennium Falcon may deploy here as a "react."

'''Dark Side:'''
When moving from here, your starships are hyperspeed +1.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Corellia]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
